mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals a tight labor market and robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which signals an impending economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months), the Federal Reserve's rate cuts prevent a severe recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in easing cycles is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250.0 thousand units signals a collapse in the housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1250.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 210.0 indicates inflationary pressures, which lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates Fed rate cuts to combat inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 210.0, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 370000.0 million dollars signals a weakening consumer sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (one quarter).
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 370000.0, or the Rank IC for RSAFS is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
